purpose: Public, profile-agnostic discovery and source evidence. Chat owns applicant eligibility and private lifecycle. This catalog describes existing artifacts, not a unified or lossless cross-source event stream.

sources.note: Use retained sequence pages for gaps; coldstart is large; fast delta is latest run only.
Changes file is not durable; retained rows from failed boards need fresh verification.
API proxy only, skip retained unverified rows for fresh discovery; not employer JD proof.
Partial public portal sample, not full JD proof.
Check health, timestamps and exact identities; raw listings may be stale and repeated.
API_LISTED and APPLY_CONTROL_ONLY are not LIVE_FORM or eligibility. Require exact title/URL/ID, freshness, and current usable route for promotion.

contract.private_data: Never put applicant history, Gmail, CV, identity, pay preferences or candidate decisions here.
contract.dedupe: Stable source identity/exact role URL, preserve meaningful requisition query and fragment IDs.
contract.consumer: Chat uses exact public evidence + private live Issue/Gmail gates; only job-resources stores applicant decisions.
